svg.title: Same current name, unresolved physical identity
svg.desc: Comparison of the historical 1976 eastward band near 13 degrees south and the modern near-equatorial mode-support region. No shared current identity or physical width is inferred.

g.text: Indian Ocean SECC: preserve the naming distinction
Source review · identity unresolved · measurement coverage unchanged
Sharma 1976 · historical named flow
At 65°E, near 13°S · May–July 1964
Reported breadth: less than 2° latitude
Eastward geostrophic band inside the SEC.
Between-station flow, referenced to 1000 dbar.
Paired edges and width layer: unknown.
Original PDF pp. 292–293, Figure 5b / §4.
No kilometre conversion or owner assignment.
Huang 2023 · near-equatorial analysis
At 80.5°E · 1995–2016 products
Mode-support region: 6°S–2.5°S
Latitude context for frequency and EOF modes.
This region is not a pair of current edges.
Physical width and annual range: unresolved.
Main-text review; supplement unreviewed.
No inherited historical width.
Admission rule: match identity, region, layer, period and boundary operator.
The 1995 XBT transport interval also includes equatorial-jet flow; it cannot supply an isolated SECC width.
Diagram compares source scope. Boxes are not maps, footprints, sampling edges or uncertainty ranges.
